judgement.one_sentence_verdict: A decent sky photo with some nice cloud formations, but the prominent streetlights and rooftops distract from the sky itself.
strengths: clear blue sky with fluffy cumulus clouds
interesting contrast between dark and light cloud layers
distinct contrail adds a nice linear element
weaknesses: composition is cluttered by streetlights and rooftops
lighting is flat and lacks dramatic impact
sky is only a portion of the frame
